prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

a warm olive complexion, late 20s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, long straight balayage hair — wearing a skin-tight ultra-high-cut micro swimsuit of ultra-thin glossy white PVC, made of two small triangle cups each edged with a thin polished chrome ring and held by thin halter strings behind her neck and back, joined to the bottom by one rigid flat polished chrome bar about one finger wide running straight down the center of her stomach from between the cups to the front of the bottom, with three round chrome rivets set along it, her waist sides, her flanks, her stomach and the skin around the bar bare, the bottom is only a small triangle at the front cut extremely high up to the very top of her hip bones, her hips, thighs and legs completely bare, the PVC shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin, fully opaque, her arms bare, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, very fine pale hair on her forearms catching the light and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. The materials show real behaviour: the polished chrome bar and rivets reflecting sharp bright highlights against her skin, the thin PVC molded so closely that it shows the dip of her navel and her hip bones, fine pull-creases and a deep mirror shine. Pose: standing with one stiletto planted in the foreground and the other foot a step behind it, one hand resting on her hip, the other arm hanging relaxed, chin tilted down, looking down toward the crowd with a calm confident look, her legs fully in view — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of glossy white PVC, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, ballerina nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, in glossy white PVC with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of oversized sculpted earrings of blackened iron and bright silver as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Middle Eastern woman with large dark eyes, strong arched brows and a straight nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme: mirror-bright glass skin dripping with wet liquid shine, blinding liquid highlighter across the cheekbones, nose bridge, forehead and chin, a flushed dewy blush, mirror-gloss lips.

Background: the famous scramble crossing of Shibuya at night with towering video-screen buildings and glowing signs; her giant stiletto heel stands in the foreground like a monument, with hundreds of tiny pedestrians with umbrellas and phones, tiny taxis waiting with glowing headlights gathered in a crowd around the base of the heel, every person at their true real size and only as tall as the heel is long, all looking up at it; she is a colossal giant, her towering heels planted on the crossing asphalt, her body rising high above the crowd and the buildings, a deep dark-blue night sky behind her, the whole scene clearly visible and in focus, lit by the neon glow on her skin and the colorful city lights with gentle shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from ground level with the camera low among the crowd and tilted upward, her giant stiletto shoe and its slender heel large in the foreground at the bottom of the frame, the whole figure from the heel tips up to the top of her head completely visible rising far above the crowd, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
